finding: Can observed sacrifices reveal how a maker orders incompatible goals? In N4d, two or six conflict probes improve true-mechanism log loss by 0.095–0.987 nats when stakes are visible and 0.050–0.928 nats when stakes are hidden. Zero probes preserve the exact prior, and hiding stakes sharply weakens recovery of the weighted rule. All 12,288 cases, 108 independently reconstructed intervals, six frozen rivals and full replay verify. This is a constructed-mechanism result, not evidence about human goal priority.
